introduction: Discover Fairlocke, the Black Hall and the lost Ironstar hold. Follow Larra’s ring to Robert’s spirit, return Haldron’s crown, and learn the separate paid vault-key route and three independent equipment commissions. Exact material sources and access clues guide preparation while each accepted exchange retains its own outcome.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Ironstar has its own achievement. Reading lore, asking keywords and carrying materials award no quest credit.

Enter the Wherston Road from the northern tundra boundary at 138978. Follow the bridge and Fairlocke village to Larra’s garden. Behind the waterfall is the Black Hall; its school rooms, lower ladder and ancient dwarven ruins form the main exploration route. Flight, water, darkness, door state and survival need actual qualification.

Recover the black skull key in the kitchen and open the locked office desk for Larra’s gold wedding ring. Return it to Larra for Robert’s gold-and-silver ring, then meet Robert’s actual spirit for Soulcatcher. Zrack starts by the dragon, not in his office. The two accepted deliveries are separate; supplied ring material fits.

The king’s tomb is down from the newly excavated area. Its raw door declares the dagger mold as a key, but the two D resets open and unlock that route. Do not invent a mandatory vault-first mold dependency or a circular crown quest from the prototype alone. Shared or later closed state may differ.

Return the old adamantium crown to Dralor for a runed darksteel axe. His trading station has a closed secret entrance. The axe plus 500 platinum produces a vault key in the native recipe; current durable coin-offering support blocks that paid exchange. His completion prose mentions crown and axe together, but the actual paid inputs are axe and fee.

Three successive southward vault locks use the silver mithril key from the third baby-dragon reset, the large mithril key inside riverside gravel, and Dralor’s paid vault key. Reverse doors have different key/state definitions. A key receipt, copied room prose or possession alone does not certify an unlock or arrival.

The vault contains both distinct mithril molds, other equipment and imported ore. Reforging either mold needs the minion’s demonhide scroll, Maltheas’s broken weapon and its own 1000-platinum fee. The intact burning blade is a separate weapon, not the broken offering. Shared cap-one materials cannot be spent twice.

Dragonbone mail uses Charringdeath’s declared scales and a 100-platinum fee. Mail, dagger and hammer are equipment services, separate from the four named story outcomes. All four paid native recipes remain guarded until durable coin offering is supported; material readiness does not establish wallet readiness or accepted payment.

The black velvet spellbook contains the word Datherlion. The underground grate uses a magic-word lock: saying the matching word can unlock an actually locked grate, but the zone’s normal D resets already open both sides. SAY does not itself open a closed door or award a learned-topic achievement.

River currents, waterfall falls, underwater breathing and native item traps are actual hazards. The surface river bends east at 138911 while its current direction remains south; that mismatch needs a bounded source/behavior review before an isolated repair. The map does not treat an attempted command or surviving hint as successful passage.

Robert’s nominal seventy-five-percent and Urian’s apprentice’s eighty-percent placement need admitted initial/forced placement and actual wandering qualification. Normal unforced active-accounting reset does not admit these lower-chance M commands, and legacy item resets require admitted generation. Source declarations do not promise daily stock.

Marius’s teaching, the lovers’ reunion, rebuilding Ironstar, reading globe histories, and Urian’s letter are contextual stories without reviewed accepted endpoints. Preserve that lore; let builders specify committed actor, dialogue, access or campaign objectives before granting semantic milestones.

Supplied exact loose material fits all native recipes. Earlier Larra or crown receipts are optional history, cannot replenish spent items and do not certify the current object’s original source. Robert’s D1 retirement under reset mode one requires renewal qualification before assigning repeated dailies.

contacts.name: Larra
contacts.description: Larra starts in the overgrown garden behind her house at 138961. Return the gold wedding ring from the office desk for Robert’s gold-and-silver ring. Her grief and Robert’s story are lore; acceptance does not implement an escorted reunion.

contacts.name: the spirit of Robert
contacts.description: Robert’s spirit starts on the Wherston Road at 138900 with nominal seventy-five-percent placement, may wander within the zone, and departs after accepting the gold-and-silver ring for Soulcatcher. The unused random rooms do not prove his placement or renewal.

contacts.name: Dralor
contacts.description: Dralor is in the trading company behind a closed secret southern entrance at 138980. Crown yields darksteel axe; axe plus fee yields vault key. Dragonbone mail, dagger and hammer are paid equipment services with independent inputs. No local shop file makes his narrated stock an actual shop.

contacts.name: Zrack
contacts.description: Zrack starts with Charringdeath at 138977, rather than in his office. His office desk contains Larra’s wedding ring. The office’s red and black globe extra-descriptions tell the dragon and Maltheas histories without implemented globe actions or quest credit.

contacts.name: Maltheas
contacts.description: Maltheas starts at 138998 with two following angels. He carries broken Fury and separately wields the intact burning blade. No literal local assigned combat routine establishes a required player-driven break, personal kill or story finale.

contacts.name: Charringdeath
contacts.description: Charringdeath starts at the Dragon’s Rest 138977 carrying the scales for Dralor’s mail commission. The skeletal dragon and its lore are distinct from a recorded original dragon kill or skinning.

contacts.name: a minion of Nakral
contacts.description: The minion of Nakral starts at cavern turn 138976 carrying the demonhide scroll and the note about the underground river. Two following guardian skeletons are separate owners; neither carries this scroll.

contacts.name: a skeletal baby dragon
contacts.description: Four skeletal baby dragons start at battle chamber 138984. Only the third reset declares the silver mithril key for the first vault lock; not every similar dragon has it.

contacts.name: Marius
contacts.description: Marius starts in the Forum at 138939. His office journal and senior portrait explain Robert, Larra and the school. His graduation and teaching are lore: this prototype has no ACT_TEACHER flag or reviewed local teaching special.

contacts.name: Faethor
contacts.description: Faethor starts on the ladder at 138967 with following undead and a wight. His relationship to Ali and the senior school history supplies context, without a native accepted couple or escort outcome.

contacts.name: Ali
contacts.description: Ali starts in the excavated area at 138970 with following undead and a wight. Her portrait and relationship to Faethor are lore, not a reviewed quest completion or a new source for either ring.

contacts.name: an apprentice of Urian
contacts.description: Urian’s apprentice starts on the Wherston Road at 138900 with nominal eighty-percent placement and an equipped sealed letter. The letter describes another group’s operations; no reviewed local or foreign native exchange accepts it.

contacts.name: Daxion, the duergar miner
contacts.description: Daxion starts at underground river bank 138987 with following dwarven undead. Gravel there contains the large mithril key for the second vault lock. The gravel, not the miner’s inventory, owns that key.

contacts.name: Joseph McLarun
contacts.description: Joseph McLarun starts in the maintained village house at 138960. His household and the desolate village provide context without an accepted rescue, repair or household quest terminal.

contacts.name: Kathrine
contacts.description: Kathrine starts in the Black Hall kitchen at 138941, where the black skull desk key is ground-declared. Meeting her does not transfer or credit the key.
